title: Social Networks and the Propagation of Household Shocks to Asset Prices
abstract: arXiv:2611.01540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When can local household disturbances move credit prices? I develop a financially weighted propagation operator on the social network. In a conditional household-intermediary equilibrium, its projection determines the household-demand component of the excess bond premium. Because responses decay at different rates across network patterns and channels, a location's relative financial importance generically changes with the horizon, so no single centrality measure summarizes exposure across horizons. Household measurements recover this projection exactly when they span independently measured demand sensitivities. Empirically, social exposure to storm-damaged counties is negatively associated with spending weeks later in counties outside the recorded footprints. translated_title: 社会网络与家庭冲击向资产价格的传播
translated_abstract: 家庭层面的局部扰动何时能够影响信贷价格？我在社会网络上构建了一个金融加权的传播算子。在一个条件性的家庭—中介均衡中，该算子的投影决定了超额债券溢价中的家庭需求成分。由于响应在不同网络模式与渠道下以不同速率衰减，一个地区的相对金融重要性通常会随时间跨度（期限）而变化，因此没有任何单一的中心性指标能够概括跨期限的风险敞口。当家庭层面的度量能够张成独立测量的需求敏感性时，即可精确恢复这一投影。实证上，与遭受风暴袭击各县的社会关联度，与数周后位于受灾记录范围之外地区的支出呈负相关。在基于观测网络并遵循模型扩散规律的模拟中，该算子对留出样本风暴的传播信贷溢价成分的预测误差约低30%……
tldr: 该论文在社会网络上构建了一个金融加权的传播算子，证明家庭局部冲击会经由社会网络传播并影响信贷价格（超额债券溢价），且由于不同网络模式下响应衰减速率不同，没有任何单一中心性指标能概括跨期限的风险敞口，并以风暴冲击数据实证验证了这一机制。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a financially weighted propagation operator on social networks to show how local household shocks propagate to asset prices (the excess bond premium), demonstrating that because responses decay at different rates across network patterns and channels, no single centrality measure can summarize exposure across horizons, and validates the mechanism empirically using storm-shock data.
